title: Simpler Options
description: Simplifies the options of multiple mods.
body: # Simpler Options ![Affiliate](https://i.imgur.com/1O8Piaf.png)\ ### This mod is complementary to other mods. It simplifies complex mod settings to make them as Vanilla-like as possible. As of now, the compatible mods are: LambDynamicLights and LambdaBetterGrass. For, LambDynamicLights, it removes the menu button from the Video Settings and adds a simple "Dynamic Lights" button which allows you to choose between: OFF, Fast, and Fancy, similarly to Optifine. And for LambdaBetterGrass, it also removes the menu button from the Video Settings and adds its own simple "Better Grass" button which allows (again!) to choose between Off, Fast, and Fancy, in, (again!!) a similar way to Optifine.
